metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: Fresh execution after the earlier interrupted attempt became unavailable; earlier material is preserved separately and is not combined into this run. Shared host and instructional isolation, external acquisition/cache timing and unavailable resolved models/native usage limit comparisons. The observer checks precede later main fixes; the 68-assertion suite precedes only the final presentation utility change, while final state/render frames identify delivery bytes. Inherited narrow navigation is long and outer gallery copy remains English. Local Chromium and controlled frame observations do not establish other engines, physical mobile interaction, screen-reader speech, continuous playback or human acceptance.
